items.title: Vance says Iran will allow nuclear inspectors back into the country
items.description: The US vice-president says a great deal of progress has been made after the first round of talks between the US and Iran.

items.title: At least 13 killed and dozens injured after Qatar gas explosion
items.description: The city's main liquified natural gas (LNG) processing site suffered a "technical accident" in the Ras Laffan industrial zone.

items.title: Myanmar army killed over 700 civilians in six months, UN says
items.description: The new UN report says the 702 civilian deaths over six months last year included 153 children.

items.title: Russian troop build-up threatens city seen as key to seizing Ukraine's Donbas
items.description: If Kostyantynivka falls, Russian forces would be able push towards Ukraine's last remaining strongholds in the east.

items.title: Clive Davis, music mogul behind Whitney Houston and Bruce Springsteen, dies aged 94
items.description: The record company executive also worked with Billy Joel, Pink Floyd, Alicia Keys and Aerosmith.

items.title: Red heat alerts issued in France, Italy and Spain as 40C temperatures forecast
items.description: The heatwave conditions are forecast to intensify in the coming days across central and western Europe.

items.title: WhatsApp to be led by Indian start-up founder as Will Cathcart steps back
items.description: WhatsApp's leadership shake-up comes as Meta looks to strengthen its app's already booming presence in India.

items.title: Kenya minister found in contempt of court over US-backed Ebola centre
items.description: Aden Duale defied a High Court order to stop building work on a controversial US-funded facility.

items.title: Twins marry twins in joyous Nigerian joint wedding
items.description: Brothers Taiwo and Kehinde Oguntoye speak to the BBC after getting hitched to twin sisters.

items.title: Largest ever cocaine bust in Australia after police raid underground bunker
items.description: Police seized 2.7 tonnes of cocaine worth an estimated A$816m after searching a property in western Sydney.

items.title: Trump-backed political outsider wins Colombia election, initial count shows
items.description: Abelardo de la Espriella appears to have narrowly defeated his rival Iván Cepeda, who says the preliminary count is "not yet official or binding".

items.title: Former Kenyan justice minister blocked from entering Uganda, lawyers' body says
items.description: Martha  Karua is a lawyer representing detained Ugandan opposition leader Kizza Besigye who is on trial for treason.
